        if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["yaw"] - obj["long_axis_yaw"]) < 0.1:

target_spot = None
for spot in spots["spots"]:

lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
